_comment: User-editable model prices in USD per MILLION tokens. Overrides the built-in tables in src/utils/costs.py. Precedence: env var > this file's 'models' > built-in table > this file's 'provider_defaults' > built-in provider default. Entries with in/out <= 0 are ignored (treated as 'not set'). Use this to set your endpoint's real rates (e.g. a eu-central-1 MaaS deployment) and to add models the built-in tables do not ship. Editable from the ComfyUI agentY settings.
